products.name: 灰烬骨架
products.lockedDesign: Black/graphite low elongated technical runner. Grey WHITE ASH marbling only on the perforated flowing overlay cage, with large oval openings revealing black mesh. Black round laces, black loop tabs tongue and heel. Multi-lobed graphite sole, rear flared horizontally but not taller platform. Preserve dark molded heel strap and tiny recessed gate, no bright new side logo.

products.name: 链序厚底
products.lockedDesign: Charcoal-black exaggerated chunky layered runner, aged washed dark finish. FOUR successive pairs of gray elongated leaf/chamber side patches form a horizontal chain, narrow horizontal gaps and tiny dark red junction stitches. Large black mesh panels, black-speckled round laces, black heel piece with recessed gate. Bulky layered dark sole with side gray diamond-grid insert and angular outsole pods. Do not flatten sole or replace chain with lettering.

products.name: 骨白笼影
products.lockedDesign: Bone/ivory long low technical runner. Flowing bone colored thin double ribs form curved vertical CAGE over cream open mesh, tiny muted red links at their joins. Thin ivory cables/straps wrap forefoot and run around side. Large rearward extended oval sole pod and separated forefoot blocks, aged off-white abrasion at bottom. Entire shoe ivory except tiny dark-red links. Preserve rear pull loop; no black large side logo.

products.name: 银浪厚底
products.lockedDesign: Silver mesh fashion chunky runner, glossy distressed silver flowing layers with black thin wave outlines, small black paired gate at center side mesh panel. Bone-white thick smooth sculptural platform midsole with molded pill and teardrop recesses, black thin outsole pods. Silver-gray laces, BLACK lining and black heel/tongue pull loops. Keep silver, not gold, maintain thick heel and broad rounded toe.

products.name: 沙色流线
products.lockedDesign: Sand/cream long technical runner with open beige mesh, gray/taupe pointed flowing overlays, small dark gate on lateral heel, silver-gray translucent angular wave HEEL CAGE flowing downward to midsole; tiny burgundy stitching at heel tab. Sculpted cream rippled midsole and TAN outsole blocks and toe bumper. Maintain extended low toe and bulky rear cage. No black sole, no giant central new logo.

jobs.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a six-view PRODUCT CONCEPT atlas, one landscape 4:3 image in an EXACT 3-column 2-row equal cell layout. Input1 authoritative selected MOVERNO shoe. Input2 exact gate emblem only. Input3 exact wordmark only. Do NOT redesign shoe. Preserve: Black/graphite low elongated technical runner. Grey WHITE ASH marbling only on the perforated flowing overlay cage, with large oval openings revealing black mesh. Black round laces, black loop tabs tongue and heel. Multi-lobed graphite sole, rear flared horizontally but not taller platform. Preserve dark molded heel strap and tiny recessed gate, no bright new side logo. Top row left-to-right: OUTER lateral profile, INNER medial profile, FRONT straight-on. Bottom row: REAR straight-on, TOP-DOWN with toe toward bottom, OUTSOLE bottom with toe toward top. Six full shoes, one per cell, entirely contained, adequate breathing space, gray neutral seamless background consistent across cells, soft catalog light. Every view same shoe geometry and sole volume. Preserve existing exterior markings and pattern. Add restrained small MOVERNO lettering to tongue uppermost patch or loop and a small gate to rear heel center only where anatomically appropriate. Gate: two independent opposing upright curved blades, straight outer vertical edges, visible OPEN vertical center slit, not X or butterfly. New outsole is conceptual continuation of original visible rim and segments in graphite-black, with small molded MOVERNO in a recessed midfoot island. Keep text legible spelled M-O-V-E-R-N-O, no extra words, no label headings, no diagram or arrows, no new side logos or extra hardware, no colored accents beyond source. Do not paint lettering over existing cage or wrap straps. High quality photorealistic concept. NOT a techpack/measurement drawing.
